beat_the_market_an_effective_intraday_mo.title: Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for S&P500 ETF (SPY)
beat_the_market_an_effective_intraday_mo.where_to_get_it: Free PDF on the University of St. Gallen repository (alexandria.unisg.ch) or via SSRN / SFI
beat_the_market_an_effective_intraday_mo.why_promising: Intraday momentum on SPY: trade breakouts of a 'noise area' built from past intraday moves, trail with VWAP. WHY ties to dealer gamma hedging (same mechanism as Baltussen et al.).
beat_the_market_an_effective_intraday_mo.what_it_should_contain: Noise-band definition, entry every 30 min, VWAP trailing stop, vol-targeted sizing, 2007-2024 results

can_day_trading_really_be_profitable.title: Can Day Trading Really Be Profitable?
can_day_trading_really_be_profitable.where_to_get_it: SSRN abstract 4416622 -> 'Download This Paper' (free, may ask for a free SSRN login)
can_day_trading_really_be_profitable.why_promising: Opening range breakout on QQQ 2016-2023, 33% annual alpha net of commissions - same authors as the VWAP paper, directly maps onto our ORB spec on NQ. An independent replication (MQL5 blog) reports gross results reproduce but net of costs it is about zero - worth checking ourselves.
can_day_trading_really_be_profitable.what_it_should_contain: Exact ORB rules (5-min range, stop, sizing by ATR), stock-in-play filter, yearly results

dash_for_cash_monthly_market_impact_of_i.title: Dash for Cash: Monthly Market Impact of Institutional Liquidity Needs
dash_for_cash_monthly_market_impact_of_i.where_to_get_it: Free working-paper PDF on orbilu.uni.lu or aalto.fi
dash_for_cash_monthly_market_impact_of_i.why_promising: Equity prices fall into the days before month end and rise after, because institutions must raise cash for monthly payments (pensions, payroll). Classic forced-flow WHY.
dash_for_cash_monthly_market_impact_of_i.what_it_should_contain: Daily return pattern around turn of month, size of the effect in S&P 500 futures, which days to be long/short

does_overnight_news_explain_overnight_re.title: Does Overnight News Explain Overnight Returns?
does_overnight_news_explain_overnight_re.why_promising: Tests whether news flow, rather than a risk premium, drives overnight returns - helps decide which WHY behind the overnight effect is real.
does_overnight_news_explain_overnight_re.what_it_should_contain: Overnight return decomposition by news vs no-news nights

hedging_demand_and_market_intraday_momen.title: Hedging Demand and Market Intraday Momentum
hedging_demand_and_market_intraday_momen.where_to_get_it: Free PDF on Erasmus University repository (pure.eur.nl, 'Hedging Demand and Market Intraday Momentum')
hedging_demand_and_market_intraday_momen.why_promising: Return from prior close to 15:30 predicts the last 30 minutes in 60+ futures, 1974-2020. WHY: option dealers and leveraged-ETF managers who are short gamma must buy into rallies and sell into drops near the close.
hedging_demand_and_market_intraday_momen.what_it_should_contain: Last-30-min predictability by asset class and by gamma level; reversal over following days; strategy returns

the_overnight_drift.title: The Overnight Drift
the_overnight_drift.where_to_get_it: Free NY Fed Staff Report 917 PDF (newyorkfed.org)
the_overnight_drift.why_promising: E-mini returns concentrated around 2-3 a.m. ET (European open), explained by dealers' inventory risk from end-of-day order imbalances. Their July 2026 follow-up (Liberty Street Economics, 'The Disappearing Overnight Drift') says the effect has been near zero since 2021 - a direct test of Conti's overnight claim.
the_overnight_drift.what_it_should_contain: Hour-by-hour E-mini returns 1998-2020, link to closing order imbalance; timing rules for an overnight window

the_pre_fomc_announcement_drift.title: The Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift
the_pre_fomc_announcement_drift.where_to_get_it: NY Fed Staff Report 512 (free on newyorkfed.org) - search 'Lucca Moench pre-FOMC announcement drift staff report'
the_pre_fomc_announcement_drift.why_promising: S&P 500 rose a large share of its total return in the 24 hours before scheduled FOMC announcements. Later work (SSRN 'The Disappearing Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift') says it faded - test both on ES.
the_pre_fomc_announcement_drift.what_it_should_contain: Return in the 24h before 14:00 ET FOMC releases, 1994-2011; needs a list of FOMC dates (public)
